snippet.title: Weed Supermarket Simulator - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Grow weed and grow your business! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4156580/Weed_Supermarket_Simulator/

Run your own weed supermarket, manage stock and prices, grow and test new strains, and serve customers. Upgrade your shop, improve your weed, and make smart decisions to keep customers coming back.
